Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted “operator” as the website operator (Wikipedia/Wikimedia) rather than the United States Navy (the operator of USS Zigzag and of the destroyer classes), and thus answered about the Wikipedia logo instead of the Navy SEAL acronym.
